facts.fact: The World Bank says investments in a Unified Social Registry and CORE-MIS enable transparent targeting and have established the foundations of Burundi's national social protection system, used to identify over 100,000 flood- and food-crisis-affected households.

The World Bank says Merankabandi's Social Registry is also used by the Soleil-Nyakiriza solar energy project to reach vulnerable households, and that the systems are increasingly used across sectors and by other programmes.
